title: Worker panes deny permission prompts instead of waiting on them
notes: From the Claude releases research (docs/research once #? lands; /tmp/research-keep/claude-news.md). Claude Code 2.1.319 added permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting: a call that would wait on a permission prompt is denied and the turn goes on. Today a worker that hits a prompt sits blocked and holds a pane-pool slot (workers-decision-11) until someone notices. Do: confirm the setting's exact name and behaviour in the Claude Code docs/changelog first; then set it for worker sessions only (the settings or flags the app passes when it starts a worker; main and user-typed sessions keep prompting), so a denied call shows up in the worker's report instead of a silent stall. Decision module and test for which sessions get it; workers docs updated.

comments.body: Report path: docs/research/claude-releases-2026-09-27-to-11-27.md (#409), in place of the /tmp one named in the notes.
Pull request #412 opened: Workers deny a permission prompt instead of waiting on it https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/412

User decision: accept that denyInsteadOfPrompting also denies a worker's questions to the user. A worker carries on and reports its open questions to main, which brings them to the user. Reason: a worker stopped on a question holds a pool slot until someone looks at its pane.
